messages:
maria: Quick sync 1: Im opening a small docs PR to add a compact tool-calling example that shows fallback parsing + a minimal JSON schema. Need fast pre-checks so I dont miss link or SDK-snippet issues.

sam: sounds good. include a test prompt + expected parsed result so QA can auto-check.

maria: draft flow: 
```
User: 'Check price for item 12345'
Assistant -> GET_PRICE(item_id=12345)
Tool returns: {\"price_cents\": 1999, \"currency\": \"USD\"}
Assistant final: {\"price_display\": \"$19.99\"}
```
keep it tiny.

jake: show edgecases: tool returns null, tool errors, and how the assistant applies a shim. e.g. tool returns {\"price_cents\": null} -> doc suggests coerce null to 'unknown' or show friendly message.

olivia: add one-line SDK notes: prefer built-in parser helpers vs manual duck-typing. show both JS + Python minimal examples.

maria: JS snippet I plan to add: 
```js
// create response and validate structured output
const resp = await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-alpha', input: prompt })
// docs show using the parser util to validate/transform
const parsed = Responses.parseStructured(resp) // pseudo helper in docs
if (!parsed || parsed.price_cents == null) { /* fallback handling */ }
```

sam: for links use canonical doc ids: docs/schema-best-practices and docs/tool-fallbacks (not relative). I'll paste the exact href in the PR description.

docbot: deploy-bot: \"Docs staging build started for PR #3246\"

jake: prefer super-compact JSON Schema example inline: 
```
{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"price_cents\":{\"type\":[\"integer\",\"null\"]},\"currency\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"currency\"]}
```
add a sentence clarifying why price_cents can be null (tool failure/unknown).

olivia: Python snippet: show typing and a validate call. e.g. 
```py
from typing import Optional
from redwood_sdk import Client, validate_structured
client = Client()
resp = client.responses.create(model='redwood-alpha', input=prompt)
parsed = validate_structured(resp)
if parsed['price_cents'] is None:
    # fallback
```

maria: will include both. also adding a one-line eval case for QA: prompt -> expected {\"price_display\": \"$19.99\"}.

sam: run the snippet sanitizer (./scripts/sanitize-snippets.sh) and link anchor pages so linkcheck doesn't fail.

jake: nit for copy: avoid phrasing that implies Redwood runtime enforces schema. make it clear parsing/validation is on the client/docs side.

maria: good catch 1; rewording guardrails blurb now.

docbot: docs-ci: \"staging build passed (lint + linkcheck) for PR #3246\"

olivia: tagging @sam @jake for review.

sam: quick pass done, left a comment to prefer the one-liner schema in the compact examples section.

jake: request to squash into steps: 1) example + eval, 2) schema and guardrail wording, 3) SDK snippets, 4) link fixes.

maria: will squash and push. planning to open follow-up issue for expanded runbook examples and more evals. pushing in ~20m. thanks! :thumbsup:

docbot: \"PR merged to main. closing thread.\"

notes: kept the example intentionally tiny so it reads well in the compact examples page; follow-up will include fuller runbook with multiple tool patterns and canonical shim functions.
